_shape: Fireflies — GraphQL. transcript(id:) returns sentences[] with speaker_name and start_time in SECONDS (a float), and meeting_attendees[] carries the invite list. There is no CRM link on the object, so matching falls back to attendee domain.
_normalizes_to: meetings[].transcript[] with ts formatted from start_time seconds

sentences.text: Thanks for making time, Priya. Before we get into the product, tell me what made you take this call.
We closed our Series B in March and the board wants us at forty million ARR in eighteen months.
Right now our reps spend the first hour of every day fixing records by hand, and I cannot hire my way out of that.
